extracted.summary: A partner at Okafor Family Law enquires about £21,000 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £123,000 and the other spouse controls the liquid assets.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To progress our review we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and the court in which the proceedings are issued, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, and a breakdown of the costs the £21,000 is intended to cover. It would also help to have details of the assets in dispute and their composition, including how the £123,000 figure is made up and what security might be available. We will also need your client's details for our standard identity and conflict checks. A member of the team will come back to you once we have had a chance to consider the information provided.
